title: Tommy Hilfiger Plans Takeover of The Plaza Hotel in New York City for Spring 2027 Fashion Show
text:
Hilfiger's show looks to blend Classic American Cool with the iconic spirit of New York City
Tommy Hilfiger , which is part of PVH Corp., plans a takeover of The Plaza hotel in New York City for the spring 2027 runway show.and will show on Sept. 10 at 2 p.m. In presenting the latest collection of prep classics, the designer will give his interpretation of New York through his own eyes.
CFDA Releases Preliminary Official New York Fashion Week Schedule for Spring 2027 Season The Plaza hotel holds a personal significance for Hilfiger. For more than a decade, he and his wife Dee made their home high above Central Park, creating a duplex penthouse within the hotel.
Returning now to one of the defining settings of his life and career, Hilfiger looks to transform“I’ve long been inspired by American icons and there are few places that embody that spirit more than The Plaza,” Hilfiger said.
“From Marilyn Monroe and Frank Sinatra to The Beatles and The Rolling Stones, generations of cultural greats have passed through its doors — and this fall we welcome in a new era of brand ambassadors and campaign stars. If those walls could talk, they would tell some of the city’s greatest stories. ”previously a Staten Island Ferry.
According to the company, the spring 2027 runway show looks to celebrate the places and personalities that continue to shape the city’s cultural identity. WWD and Women's Wear Daily are part of Penske Media Corporation. © 2026 Fairchild Publishing, LLC. All Rights Reserved.
